chapter: Chicago in the 1920s: Bix, Armstrong, Morton
title: Getting along with New Orleans musicians
summary: The interviewer asks why Howard, not from New Orleans, was used by so many of them; he says he worked with some of the earliest New Orleans bands.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
